name: farmconnect-ai
description: AI-powered market intelligence for smallholder farmers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,api,ai "npm run dev --workspace client" "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace client && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && node scripts/ai-service.mjs test
